entries.update: Branch Info — Lighthouse City/YMCA (hours, phone, amenities, membership flyer)
entries.content:
Phone: 520-795-9725 · tucsonymca.org/lighthouse

Wellness Center hours: Monday–Thursday 6am–8pm, FRIDAY 6am–6pm, Saturday 7am–4pm, Sunday 12pm–4pm.
(The printed membership flyer says Monday–Friday until 8pm — that's wrong. Lighthouse closes at 6pm on Fridays, confirmed by RJ, Sept 25, 2026.)

Amenities:
- Pool: seasonal OUTDOOR pool with aquatics classes and open swim
- Group exercise: Zumba, BodyPump, Yoga, SilverSneakers, etc.
- Cardio, strength and free-weight areas: treadmills, bikes, strength machines, dumbbells, squat rack, etc.
- Discounted youth programs: sports, Y Kids Nights, Family Nights, camps
- Personal training

The attached membership flyer's PRICES are only good through Oct 31, 2026 (after that it's hidden automatically), and its Friday hours are wrong (see above).

Source: Lighthouse membership flyer, Sept 2026; Friday hours confirmed by RJ.
